Every claim climbs the ripple of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ferrous re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Reaching the saffron of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
